rationale: C08 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both orders establish a nationally named advisory body, define a President-appointed membership chosen to represent relevant constituencies, and then assign it a recurring advisory role concerning a government program, with meetings tied to requests by the official being advised. The close correspondence in language, organization, and operative machinery is materially stronger than a generic commission-creation formula. C05 and C12 contain related commission and advisory structures, but their language and functional sequence correspond less closely.

shared_material.child_excerpt: There is hereby established the National Agricultural Advisory Commission, hereinafter referred to as the Commission, which shall be composed of eighteen members who shall be appointed by the President
shared_material.parent_excerpt: There is hereby established the National Advisory Board on Mobilization Policy, hereinafter referred to as the Board, which shall be composed of the Director of Defense Mobilization, as Chairman, and sixteen other members ... who shall be appointed by the President.
shared_material.explanation: Both begin with nearly identical establishment, naming, defined-reference, composition, and presidential-appointment machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: At least twelve of the members of the Commission shall be representative farmers. The members ... shall be appointed with a view toward granting appropriate representation to the several geographic sections of the United States.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: All of the members of the Board shall represent the general public and the public interest, but ... four members ... shall have had experience in business management, four ... in matters relating to labor, and four ... in agriculture.
shared_material.explanation: Both prescribe constituency-based membership designed to give the advisory body representative experience, adapted in the child specifically to farmers and geographic regions.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Commission shall from time to time, upon the request of the Secretary of Agriculture ... review the policies and administration of farm programs ... and ... advise the Secretary in regard thereto. The Commission shall meet at such times and places as the Secretary shall designate.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: It shall be the function of the Board to advise the President from time to time with respect to the current defense mobilization program or any phase thereof. The Board shall meet with the President at his request and shall meet at such other times as may be determined by its Chairman.
shared_material.explanation: This is a distinctive parallel operative sequence: advise from time to time concerning a government program or part of it, with meetings controlled by the official receiving the advice.
